I really like this [whole album](https://open.spotify.com/album/2Kq0O56yHIBpLJ0Oc2FjGe?si=N0spBqM2SZeaxjJLB12_pg). [_All The Time_](https://open.spotify.com/track/6LJo0TOJC9FxawN8qyzmNX?si=853edc20ed064510) is another one of my favorites on it. This one though stands out though. The lyrics are so benign and vague (e.g., _"I need you to know we've really got this now."_), but in a deep sense, and that's why I like it for some reason.
